items.title: 00:11 · Sense one defines racism as individual prejudice
items.detail: Sense one defines racism as individual prejudice, hostility, or discrimination directed against another person on the basis of race or ethnicity.

items.title: 00:19 · Sense two defines racism as an ideological
items.detail: Sense two defines racism as an ideological belief or doctrine holding that inherent biological differences among human racial groups determine cultural or intellectual achievement.

items.title: 00:29 · Sense three when the dictionary includes a
items.detail: Sense three, when the dictionary includes a third sense at all, mentions institutional or systemic practices that produce unequal outcomes across racial categories.
